items.headline: [US Featured Stock] Albemarle strong following Mizuho upgrade
items.snippet: Mizuho raised Albemarle to Outperform, maintained $130 PT (~33% upside). Lithium carbonate seen rising from $18,375/t to $22,500 by end of next year.

items.headline: Albemarle upgraded to Outperform from Neutral at Mizuho
items.snippet: Mizuho upgraded Albemarle to Outperform from Neutral with an unchanged $130 price target. Strong Battery Energy Storage - BESS - demand has tipped the market balance into a favorable territory.

items.headline: Bear of the Day: Albemarle Corporation (ALB)
items.snippet: Albemarle's earnings outlook dropped 13% for Q3 and 36% for Q4 since its Q2 release; Zacks Rank #5 (Strong Sell).

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $135 from $230 at Argus
items.snippet: Argus lowered PT to $135 from $230, keeps Buy. Supply/demand trends appear poised to improve into 2027.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $175 from $200 at BMO Capital
items.snippet: BMO lowered PT to $175 from $200, keeps Outperform; lithium group viewed as oversold after spot weakness.

items.headline: Albemarle Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
items.snippet: Management emphasized the tight lithium market due to strong EV and stationary storage demand, with supply lagging. Maintained 2026 outlook, expecting high end of scenario ranges.
